name: Hannah
bio: Hannah has worked at Obedience Unleashed for 6 years as a Dog trainer and Senior Assistant at our Daycare/Boarding/Training facility. She brings rich multidisciplinary experience from her 8 years competing in 4H with dogs & llamas and 5 years as a professional handler for CKC show dogs competing in obedience, agility, conformation, and rally-obedience. She has earned her Excellent title in rally-obedience and is working toward her Master’s title with her current dog Oakley.
